layers.message: Run tests in CI against a PostgreSQL service
Record project context and PostgreSQL upgrade scope

graderOnly: docker-compose.yml runs postgres:14 for local development, with the named volume pgdata mounted at /var/lib/postgresql/data; that volume holds each developer's local data.
.github/workflows/ci.yml runs the tests against a postgres:14 service container.
Production runs on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 14. The database was created on PostgreSQL 11 in 2019 and upgraded in place to 14 in 2023.

all.why: Active Work.Architecture points to the protocol location for this cycle's design
the design carries ARCHITECTURE provenance for the active cycle

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem
Architect writes no production code, configuration, tests, or user documentation

selfChecks.why: PyPI is unreachable during the run, so the project's Python dependencies cannot be fetched
local development runs postgres:14 with the pgdata named volume at /var/lib/postgresql/data
CI runs the tests against a postgres:14 service container

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 14' docs/operations.md && grep -q 'PostgreSQL 11 in 2019' docs/operations.md
selfChecks.why: docs/operations.md records the RDS production database and its upgrade history
the starting workflow state is valid

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture for ledger-api (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, psycopg 3). Pre-install layers: 50-project commits the app, the Alembic migration, tests, Dockerfile, README, .env.example, and docker-compose.yml (service db on postgres:14, POSTGRES_DB ledger_dev, user and password from the environment, pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data, port 5432, pg_isready health check; service api; top-level volume pgdata). 51-ci adds .github/workflows/ci.yml (test job with a postgres:14 service, POSTGRES_DB ledger_test). 52-operations adds docs/operations.md (RDS for PostgreSQL 14, Multi-AZ, 7-day automated backups, about 40 GB, created on 11 in 2019 and upgraded in place to 14 in 2023 with about 12 minutes unavailable, API is the only client, DATABASE_URL from deployment secrets). After install, 60-cycle commits STATE.md (ARCHITECTING, STANDARD, FULL_DELIVERABLE, the case's cycle id, Scope set, Architecture and Development NONE, FORWARD from SCOPING, recovery and obligations inactive), MODE.md (BROWNFIELD), Auditor CONTEXT.md describing the three environments and the single-client fact, and the SCOPE record with AC-001 to AC-003 worded as in the case, the outage and rollback constraints, and the AWS-access assumption; the November 2026 end of life is background in the Goal only. No design document or prior-cycle record exists. The repository avoids every leak-guard string and names no PostgreSQL 15 to 18, support policy, data-directory layout, password hashing, or authentication method. Tests need a database and PyPI packages, so no selfCheck runs them; registries and Debian mirrors are blocked.
